text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"All riiight! We did it!! I, am, in, 1st 
place!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The cheers were amazing too, wasn't it! 
Everyone seemed so happy, and that's the 
best part♪
choice_data_list:
Don't let your guard down—let's aim for 
victory again next time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Trainer is totally satisfied! All 
that hard work really paid off~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll do my best to leave everyone 
super satisfied next time too~! Mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! Carelessness is our greatest 
enemy! Things get scariest right when you 
get cocky~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll do my best with a 
challenger's mindset! Let's do this! Ei, 
ei, mun!
